title: Legacy Issue #232/#236/#237 Dashboard E2E still targets the pre-#304 Keys & Spots tab shell
summary: Thirteen reviewed default-E2E specs still enter /keys through e2e/support/keys-spots.ts, which requires a Keys & Spots tablist with an outer Physical Resources tab. Current production KeysPage explicitly renders the #304 Option 3 ResourceInspectorLive directly and no longer exposes those former page-level tabs. The assigned legacy tests therefore encode obsolete UI navigation even where their underlying race, idempotency, privacy and authority intents remain valid.
severity_rationale: This is test-suite debt, not a demonstrated product defect or security bypass. The current Dashboard CI gate runs test:e2e:runtime against ./e2e-runtime, so the stale default ./e2e paths are not shown to block current CI. They can still fail or misrepresent coverage when pnpm --filter @valet/dashboard test:e2e is run manually or by another workflow.

source_chain.observation: enterKeysSpots expects an h1 named Keys & Spots; openPhysicalResources requires role=tablist name=Keys & Spots and tab name=Physical Resources.
The reviewed legacy test explicitly drives the former Operational Keys / Physical Resources outer tabs.
Current source states Exact Option 3 interior replaces both former Keys & Spots page-level tabs and renders ResourceInspectorLive directly.
Current Option 3 surface is Resource inspector with direct Key Slots/Parking Spots family buttons and add actions, not the former outer tab shell.
Current #304 test contract enters /keys and expects the Resource Inspector directly after exact Location selection.
Current #304 suite exercises live pagination and A→B→A reset on ResourceInspectorLive, preserving an important legacy safety intent on the new UI.

evidence.observation: Default Playwright testDir is ./e2e, which contains the affected issue232/236/237 specs.

underlying_intents_still_present: Current physical-resource mutation code retains identity/location/draft-keyed operation IDs and explicit user retry after uncertain/MFA outcomes.
Current authoritative reads use scope/generation fencing and AbortController semantics.
Current ResourceInspectorLive uses request epochs and aborts appended-page requests on filter/scope/disposal transitions.
Dedicated #304 tests cover current Resource Inspector authority, interactions, paging, accessibility and visual behavior.
competing_explanations: The legacy specs may intentionally be retained as historical documentation, but they are still executable by the package's default test:e2e command and therefore are not inert documentation.
A compatibility wrapper could theoretically recreate the former tab semantics, but current KeysPage and the #304 contract explicitly define direct Resource Inspector entry instead.
recommended_followup: Migrate or retire the affected default-E2E specs and support/keys-spots.ts against the accepted #304 Resource Inspector contract while preserving their race/idempotency/privacy/authority assertions. Do not change the frozen Option 3 UI solely to satisfy the obsolete tests.
